dn33:3.1.183: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayita nirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.

dn33:3.2.17: anatthaṃ me carissatī ti taṃ kutettha labbhā ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, anātthaṃ me carissatī ti taṃ kutettha labbhā ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
dn33:3.2.20: anatthaṃ carissatīti taṃ kutettha labbhā ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
dn33:3.2.23: atthaṃ carissatī ti, taṃ kutettha labbhā ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
dn33:3.2.25: santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā nānatta saññino seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
dn33:3.2.27: santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi. devā brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā.
dn33:3.2.29: santāvuso sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino seyyathāpi devā ābhassarā.
dn33:3.2.31: santāvuso, sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā.
dn33:3.2.33: santāvuso, sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino seyyathāpi devā asaññasattā.
dn33:3.2.35: santāvuso, sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.37: santāvuso, sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññānaṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.39: santāvuso, sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.41: santāvuso, sattā sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā.
dn33:3.2.44: idhāvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito,
dn33:3.2.45: ayaṃ ca puggalo nirayaṃ upapanno hoti.
dn33:3.2.47: puna caparaṃ āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito.
dn33:3.2.48: ayaṃ ca puggalo tiracchānayoniṃ upapanno hoti.
dn33:3.2.60: paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti milakkhesu aviññātāresu yattha natthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
dn33:3.2.62: puna caparaṃ āvuso, tathāgatoca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. ayaṃ ca puggalo
dn33:3.2.63: majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. so ca hoti micchādiṭṭhiko viparītadassano
dn33:3.2.64: natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imaṃ ca lokaṃ paraṃ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
dn33:3.2.66: puna caparaṃ āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. ayaṃ ca puggalo
dn33:3.2.67: majjhimesu janapadesupaccājāto hoti. so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo na paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ.
dn33:3.2.69: puna caparaṃ āvuso, tathāgato ca loke na uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
dn33:3.2.70: dhammo ca na desīyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. ayaṃ ca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ.
dn33:3.2.73: idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.74: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.75: pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.76: sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.77: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

dn33:3.2.79: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

dn33:3.2.81: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.2.83: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti.
dn33:3.2.84: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti.
dn33:3.2.85: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti.
dn33:3.2.86: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti.
dn33:3.2.91: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
dn33:3.2.92: ime kho āvuso tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena nava dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:3.2.93: tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ …pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. dasakaṃ
dn33:3.3.1: atthi kho āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:3.3.2: tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ …pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn33:3.3.5: idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī. samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn33:3.3.6: yaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn33:3.3.8: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpā’ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
dn33:3.3.9: yampāvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto hoti …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
dn33:3.3.11: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅke.
dn33:3.3.12: yampāvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
dn33:3.3.14: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu suvaco hoti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
dn33:3.3.15: yampāvuso, bhikkhu suvaco hoti …pe… padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
dn33:3.3.17: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
dn33:3.3.18: yampāvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ …pe… alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
dn33:3.3.20: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo.
dn33:3.3.21: yampāvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti …pe… abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo,
dn33:3.3.23: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarehi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi.
dn33:3.3.26: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
dn33:3.3.27: yampāvuso, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati …pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
dn33:3.3.29: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
dn33:3.3.30: yampāvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti …pe… saritā anussaritā.
dn33:3.3.32: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
dn33:3.3.33: yampāvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
dn33:3.3.36: paṭhavīkasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
dn33:3.3.45: viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
dn33:3.3.47: pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, byāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi.
dn33:3.3.49: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi.
dn33:3.3.51: idhāvuso, bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti chaḷaṅgasamannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panunnapaccekasacco samavayasaṭṭhesano anāvilasaṃkappo passaddhakāyasaṃkhāro suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.
dn33:3.3.53: idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thinamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti.
dn33:3.3.54: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti.
dn33:3.3.56: idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
dn33:3.3.57: sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
dn33:3.3.58: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno.
dn33:3.3.59: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
dn33:3.3.61: idhāvuso, bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti.
dn33:3.3.62: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti.
dn33:3.3.64: idhāvuso, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ parisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti.
dn33:3.3.65: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti.
dn33:3.3.67: idhāvuso, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni sabbāni tāni nunnāni honti panunnāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭippassaddhāni.
dn33:3.3.68: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu panunnapaccekasacco hoti-
dn33:3.3.70: idhāvuso bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti, bhavesanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā hoti.
dn33:3.3.71: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
dn33:3.3.73: idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, byāpādasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, vihiṃsāsaṃkappo pahīno hoti.
dn33:3.3.74: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti.
dn33:3.3.76: idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn33:3.3.77: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti.
dn33:3.3.79: idhāvuso bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti.
dn33:3.3.80: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti.
dn33:3.3.82: idhāvuso, bhikkhu rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ gato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammoti pajānāti,
dn33:3.3.84: moho me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ gato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammoti pajānāti.
dn33:3.3.85: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti.
dn33:3.3.87: asekkhā sammādiṭṭhi, asekkho sammāsaṅkappo, asekkhā sammāvācā, asekkho sammākammanto, asekkho sammāājīvo, asekkho sammāvāyāmo, asekkhā sammāsati, asekkho sammāsamādhi, asekkhaṃ sammāñāṇaṃ, asekkhā sammāvimutti.
dn33:3.3.88: ime kho āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa dhammā sammadakkhātā.
dn33:3.3.89: tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ. tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
dn33:3.4.1: atha kho bhagavā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn33:3.4.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ saṅgītipariyāyaṃ abhāsī”ti.
dn33:3.4.4: idamavoca āyasmā sāriputto. samanuñño satthā ahosi.
dn33:3.4.5: attamanā ca te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
